agent.result_text:
The thrust total now leaves out one highest and one lowest contribution whenever at least two people contribute, and `bin/e2e` passes.

**What changed:** Sheet totals are worked out in the browser, so the change is all in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people-list.ts`. I added a shared helper, `trimmedTotal`, and the thrust total now goes through it. It works like this:
- People whose thrust is n/a don't count as contributing.
- If fewer than two people contribute, the total is just the plain sum.
- Otherwise it takes off one highest and one lowest value. If several people tie, only one of them is left out.

Any total added later should use `trimmedTotal` too. Nothing makes that happen automatically, so it has to be called each time.

**Checked against the test's data:** The thrust values are 15, 12, 20, 12, 8, 10 and 8, which add up to 85. Removing the highest (20) and one of the two 8s leaves 57, which is what the test expects. People on hold still count towards the total; the expected 57 only works out that way.

The server, the stored data and the test endpoints didn't need any changes.
